'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites]], [[March 2025 Western Syria clashes]]
****Spiritual leader of [[Syria]]'s [[Druze in Syria|Druze community]] [[Hikmat al-Hajari]] rejects any deal with the new [[Ahmed al-Sharaa]]-headed [[First Syrian transitional government|transitional government]], accusing it of being "extremist in every sense of the word" and refusing to "recognize a terrorist" in reference to the concurrent [[Sectarianism and minorities in the Syrian civil war|sectarian]] massacres of Syrian Alawites. *[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
****[[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]] claim to have killed a senior foreign [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIL]] commander responsible for orchestrating [[Drone warfare|drone attacks]] using [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|explosive-laden unmanned aerial vehicles]] in the Lugta-Huraanhur and Togga Raq-Raq valleys of the [[Cal Miskaad]] Mountains in [[Puntland]]'s [[Bari Region]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-forces-kill-isis-drone-chief-in-calmiskaad-mountains-operation (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Mar/200673/puntland_forces_kill_senior_isis_drone_commander_in_targeted_operation.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Palestinian genocide accusation]], [[Gaza genocide]]
***The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Human Rights Council|Human Rights Council]] accuses [[Israel]] of committing [[genocide|genocidal acts]] and other [[war crimes]] against [[Palestinians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], including committing [[gender-related violence|gender-based violence]] and [[sexual assault]] against [[Palestinian prisoners in Israel|prisoners]] and the [[Destruction of the healthcare system|systematic destruction]] of [[Attacks on health facilities during the Gaza war|healthcare systems]] in the region. [[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] dismisses the reports and accusations, calling them biased and "antisemitic". [https://www.dw.com/en/un-accuses-israel-of-genocidal-acts-sexual-violence-in-gaza/a-71912287 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-experts-accuse-israel-genocidal-acts-sexual-violence-gaza-2025-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
***[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says that the [[United States|U.S.]] proposal for the [[ceasefire]] in [[Ukraine]] would depend on Russia's conditions being met, and that there will be further discussions. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/03/13/putin-agrees-with-us-made-ceasefire-proposal-but-says-there-are-nuances (Euronews)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/putin-puts-heavy-conditions-on-trumps-ukraine-ceasefire-plan/ (Politico)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] announces that [[NHS England]] will be abolished in a drive to reduce [[bureaucracy]] and bring [[National Health Service]] management back under "democratic control". The move is expected to result in around 6,500 job losses. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cx29lrl826rt (BBC News)]
*[[Qatar]] begins supplying [[natural gas]] to [[Syria]] via [[Jordan]] to increase production at the [[Deir Ali]] power plant in [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]], which will provide electricity to [[Damascus]] and other [[List of cities in Syria|major cities]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/13/qatar-begins-supplying-natural-gas-to-syria-through-jordan (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[American expansionism under Donald Trump]]
**[[Panama–United States relations]]
***The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] reportedly orders the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] to plan options to expand the presence of American troops in [[Panama]] and potentially try to reclaim the [[Panama Canal]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/trump-white-house-asked-us-military-develop-options-panama-canal-offic-rcna195994 (NBC News)]
**[[Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland]]
***During a meeting at the [[White House]] with [[Secretary General of NATO]] [[Mark Rutte]], [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] refuses to rule out the U.S. [[annexation]] of [[Greenland]] when questioned. [https://news.sky.com/story/donald-trump-says-he-thinks-us-will-annex-greenland-13327945 (Sky News)]
*[[Armenia–Azerbaijan relations]]
**[[Armenia]] and [[Azerbaijan]] agree on a [[peace treaty]] to formally end the [[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]] and establish a mutually-agreed [[Armenia–Azerbaijan border|border]] between both countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/armenia-says-it-is-ready-sign-peace-agreement-with-azerbaijan-2025-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations]]
**[[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz President]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] and [[President of Tajikistan|Tajik President]] [[Emomali Rahmon]] sign a deal to formally end the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]] dispute between [[Kyrgyzstan]] and [[Tajikistan]]. Railways, roads, and air transport resumes between both countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-sign-deal-end-long-running-border-dispute-2025-03-13/ (Reuters)]
